about: Generated by tools/design_system.py build. Do not edit.

components.name: Icon
components.subtitle: 24 line-art spots in list rows
components.summary: Icon is a small line-art spot of one piece of water-system equipment or one document, painted with a colour token, that lets a list row be recognised before it is read.

components.name: Illustration
components.subtitle: Equipment line art painted with a token
components.summary: Illustration shows an isometric line drawing of Aquemi equipment, painted with a colour token so the same file works in light and dark themes.

components.name: Page
components.subtitle: Section, container and type classes
components.summary: Page is the layout every Aquemi page, section and preview sits in: the container, the section rhythm and the type classes.

components.name: Placeholder
components.subtitle: Highlighted and clean
components.summary: Placeholder marks a fact only Aquemi can supply (a capacity, lead time, certificate, location, case-study figure) so an invented number never ships.

components.name: SplitSection
components.subtitle: Heading column left, content right
components.summary: SplitSection puts a section's heading in a sticky left column and its content on the right, so long pages alternate between full-width and two-column rhythm instead of stacking heading, text, heading, text.

components.name: Spot
components.subtitle: Equipment vignettes at 96, 128 and 160 px, on a cream plate and on navy
components.summary: Spot is a larger line drawing of one piece of water-system equipment or one stage of the work (a still, an RO skid, a storage tank, a pump), painted with a colour token, that stands for a stop on a route or a zone of a plant map the way the concept drawings do.

components.name: Button
components.subtitle: Primary, secondary, link and disabled
components.summary: Buttons start an action or move someone to the next step of an enquiry.

components.name: Footer
components.subtitle: Site footer as a drawing sheet
components.summary: Footer closes every page on navy as an engineering drawing sheet: zone frame, logo and description, four numbered sitemap columns, a title block and the contact and legal line.

components.name: NavBar
components.subtitle: Desktop header and phone menu with section jump
components.summary: The site header: logo, six numbered section tabs and one framed call to action, like the tab strip of a drawing set.

components.name: SectionNav
components.subtitle: Numbered jump links and page progress on a system page
components.summary: SectionNav is a sticky bar of numbered jump links to the sections of a long technical page, with a page progress readout, like the revision bar of a drawing set.

components.name: Band
components.subtitle: Statement band on limestone, and on sunken with an optional mark
components.summary: Band sets one short statement very large in a framed panel on a limestone or sunken ground, with a supporting line and a faint pipework drawing at the right; its ground modifiers (`aq-band--limestone`, `aq-band--sunken`, `aq-band--navy`) also change the ground for other sections.

components.name: CaseStudy
components.subtitle: Fact boxes and outcome figure; second awaits its figure; third is a template with status, profile and method; fourth is a project record (drawing, outcomes, timeline)
components.summary: CaseStudy summarizes a delivered project as framed fact boxes (client, problem, system delivered) beside one large measured-outcome figure.

components.name: Closing
components.subtitle: Closing in condensed capitals; the exchange (what you send, what comes back) on a cream plate
components.summary: Closing is the call to action at the end of every page: a very large headline in condensed capitals in a framed panel on the navy band, one lead sentence, an optional checklist or send-and-return exchange, an optional proof readout with one confirmed figure, and the primary button.

components.name: ContactRoutes
components.subtitle: Three ways in as route sheets on a plate: proposal (this page), urgent service with its call bar, shop visit; each with a 1-2-3 strip and a response clock
components.summary: ContactRoutes sets the ways into Aquemi as labelled route sheets on a drawing plate, each with its own numbered 1 → 2 → 3 strip and response clock, so a visitor on a contact page sees which route fits before the form: request a proposal, production stopped (call the service line), or visit the shop.

components.name: DocList
components.subtitle: Turnover binder: folder cards on a drawing plate, code tabs, key documents first
components.summary: DocList shows the documents delivered with a system as a turnover binder: numbered folder cards on a drawing plate with paper stacked behind, each folder tab carrying the short code a validation team files it under, with the deciding documents first and emphasized.

components.name: EvidenceMap
components.subtitle: Requirement, how we meet it, file chips or clause references
components.summary: EvidenceMap maps each requirement or standard to how we meet it and the documents that prove it, drawn as a mapping with leader lines and file-shaped chips, for the validation lead asking "where is the proof?".

components.name: Explainer
components.subtitle: One idea as a token-drawn figure plus numbered callouts: endotoxin margin
components.summary: Explainer sets out one idea as a figure plus three or four short numbered callouts instead of paragraphs, for a mechanism a reader should see at a glance (endotoxin margin set by the feed, what an upgrade costs in requalification).

components.name: FAQ
components.subtitle: Hairline accordion rows, second one open
components.summary: FAQ answers the questions engineers and QA ask before they call, as framed question cards hung from one junction spine: index, question in condensed capitals and a [ + ] sign, with the answer opening inside the card.

components.name: FaultList
components.subtitle: Failure modes that open to cause and design control
components.summary: FaultList lists where things fail and what we design against; each failure opens to its cause and the design control.

components.name: GradeLanes
components.subtitle: Minimum water grade by step, on three lanes
components.summary: GradeLanes shows the minimum water grade step by step: each step drops a tap into one of three lanes, Potable, PW and WFI.

components.name: Hero
components.subtitle: Three heroes: home loop drawing, hub index, system equipment drawing
components.summary: Hero opens every page: eyebrow, one display headline, one lead sentence, one primary button and one link.

components.name: LinkGrid
components.subtitle: Six services as linked rows: index, title, one line, standard tag, drawing
components.summary: LinkGrid sets out a list of choices (services, industries, systems, upgrade types) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, title with an arrow when it links, one line, an optional standard tag, and the linked page's drawing small at the row end on desktop.

components.name: NotesRegister
components.subtitle: Planned notes as a revision register, filtered by topic
components.summary: NotesRegister lists technical notes as an engineering drawing register (a revision table): date, note number, topic, title and standard, with topic filter chips and the latest or next planned note in a larger panel beside it.

components.name: OptionList
components.subtitle: Options as framed rows with big numbers; decisions with a ? tag and fork
components.summary: OptionList shows the configuration choices for a system as rows of the shared list grammar: index, option name and one line on what it does.

components.name: OptionModules
components.subtitle: System options as framed modules wired to the base skid drawing, on the navy
components.summary: OptionModules draws a system's equipment options as framed modules around the page's own equipment drawing (the base skid), each wired to it by a dashed hairline; it is the `as: "modules"` shape of the options block (OptionList).

components.name: ParameterCallouts
components.subtitle: Skid design parameters called out on the equipment drawing, the rest folded below
components.summary: ParameterCallouts lays a system's design parameters on its own equipment drawing, with leader lines from numbered labels to the part each one is about.

components.name: ProcessDiagram
components.subtitle: PW skid treatment train as an interactive piping flow on a plate: stations are toggles, the selected run fills and its detail opens
components.summary: ProcessDiagram draws a treatment train as an interactive piping flow on a drawing plate: each stage is a station with its equipment vignette, joined by one thick double-wall Flow pipe with arrows, and choosing a station fills its pipe run and opens that stage's detail.

components.name: ProcessSteps
components.subtitle: Steps as rows, hold flow, or stage strip with hold stamps
components.summary: ProcessSteps shows a real sequence (a project, a qualification, a service visit) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, step name and what happens.

components.name: Prose
components.subtitle: Heading left; a large lead, then paragraphs tagged [01], [02] with leaders on a drawing grid
components.summary: Prose is running text in a SplitSection: the heading on the left, the first sentence as a large lead, then paragraphs tagged [01], [02] in the margin on a faint drawing grid.

components.name: Readout
components.subtitle: One limit on an instrument face: the WFI endotoxin limit from the home page
components.summary: Readout sets one figure on a precision instrument face: the number very large, its unit vertical beside it, the method in a boxed tag on a reference line, a short caption, and a schematic tick scale along the bottom.

components.name: RelatedLinks
components.subtitle: Four pages hung from a pipe: number, thumbnail, section and title in condensed capitals
components.summary: RelatedLinks closes a page with the pages to read next as cards hung from a drawn pipe: a large number, a thumbnail of the target page, its section and its title in condensed capitals.

components.name: RoleMatrix
components.subtitle: Who writes and who reviews, as signature stamps
components.summary: RoleMatrix shows who writes, does and approves each document, like the signature blocks on a controlled document, so the split between our work and your sign-off is visible at a glance.

components.name: Router
components.subtitle: Pick your situation, see one route; pending stations dashed
components.summary: Router lets a buyer pick the situation they are in and see one route through what follows: the water they need, the system, and where to start with us.

components.name: StandardsGrid
components.subtitle: The twelve standards on the home page, code-only cards
components.summary: StandardsGrid lists the standards Aquemi designs to as numbered cards joined by thin connector lines, as a section of its own under a large headline.

components.name: StandardsMap
components.subtitle: Zones of the water system on one pipe, each labelled with the standards that govern it
components.summary: StandardsMap is a plant map of the water system: each zone (generation, storage and distribution, pure steam, controls and data, fabrication, qualification) is a framed area labelled with the standards that govern it, and every code jumps to the row further down the page that proves it.

components.name: Versus
components.subtitle: Two routes across a spine of factors, with a verdict or a conclusion band
components.summary: Versus sets two routes face to face across a spine of factors, for a buyer choosing one of two (hot or ambient WFI, multi-effect or vapour compression).

components.name: VisitRoute
components.subtitle: A preventive maintenance visit as numbered stops on one route, ending in sign-off
components.summary: VisitRoute lays a visit's checks out as numbered stops on one dashed route drawn on a cream plate, each stop a line drawing of the equipment it covers, for a walk-round whose order matters, such as what a preventive maintenance visit covers, ending at the sign-off.

components.name: WaterPath
components.subtitle: Seven system families as stations on one pipe; the selected family opens its line, standard and link
components.summary: WaterPath shows the system families as stations on one pipe, from city feed to point of use, so the reader sees how the systems connect and can open each one's line, standard and page from the drawing.

components.name: CompareTable
components.subtitle: Start from your water grade: four grades against standard and limits, with a link column
components.summary: CompareTable sets three or more options against criteria as a hairline matrix, with eyebrow column heads, numbered row labels in a narrow left column and, on phones, one record per row (or column tabs for wide tables) instead of a sideways scroll.

components.name: KeyFacts
components.subtitle: The numbers a page stands on, as a cream data plate between rulers
components.summary: KeyFacts is a measurement strip of three to six figures, each with its unit and the standard behind it, that tells an engineer what a page stands on before they read a word of copy.

components.name: LimitGauges
components.subtitle: Release limits as dials; design rules as threshold bars
components.summary: LimitGauges shows a block of water or steam quality limits as instrument faces on a cream drawing plate, one dial per limit, so a reader sees at a glance where each limit sits and which side of it passes.

components.name: PlanTiers
components.subtitle: Service plans side by side: who each suits, price, terms, one action per plan
components.summary: PlanTiers compares service plans in one table on a cream drawing plate: numbered terms down the left, one column per plan, a "Fits when" row and one action per plan, for a buyer choosing a plan tier.

components.name: SpecTable
components.subtitle: WFI spec sheet with the critical limit as a navy readout, and a comparison table
components.summary: Specification sheets present water quality limits as a two-column matrix with the one critical limit pulled out as a full-width band, the most persuasive content Aquemi has.

components.name: StandardTag
components.subtitle: Standards a system is designed to
components.summary: Standard tags name the regulation, pharmacopoeia or engineering code a system is built to.

components.name: EnquiryForm
components.subtitle: Request a proposal as a numbered data sheet
components.summary: EnquiryForm lays out a proposal, service or application request as an engineering specification data sheet: a drawn frame, numbered sections, numbered items and one submit.

components.name: TextField
components.subtitle: Default, with unit, and error
components.summary: Text fields collect enquiry and service-request details.
